tool.name: AddPrimaryNameField
tool.summary: Parse the JSON-encoded names column of Overture features and add a primary_name text field containing the default (primary) name. If the primary_name field already exists it is recalculated.

usage.bullet_item: The input features must contain a names field with JSON-encoded name data from Overture Maps.
The tool adds or updates a primary_name text field on the input feature class in place.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The feature layer or feature class containing a names column to parse.
